unassigned_dimensions.label: SR/S2 divider beam (vertical BR1, row C-D) to grid 2 (S-03 plan)
unassigned_dimensions.source_image: image/บ้าน_เล็ก_1ชั้น_13/บ้าน_เล็ก_1ชั้น_13_หน้า21.png
unassigned_dimensions.note: NOT B4's span — B4 runs the full D1-D2 = 4.50 (both leaders land on columns). This dimension places the SR/S2 divider at 4.50 − 2.87 = 1.63m east of grid 1, which a pixel scan of the PNG confirms is the divider beam's own centreline (1.63 ± 0.06). Left as an unassigned dimension rather than a dummy x_line because a third dummy between grid 1 and 1" needs a naming ruling first — see this file's dummy-grid-naming warning and the plan_beam file warnings
